newsitem.title: USA: Gateway says company not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Gateway says company not for sale.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc, which on Thursday announced it agreed to buy computer server maker Advanced Logic Research Inc (ALR), said the company is not for sale.

Responding to reporters' questions on a conference call regarding recent reports that Gateway and Compaq Computer Corp had been in talks to merge, Gateway founder, chairman and chief executive said, "I can say completely that Gateway is not for sale, and we're looking to broaden our horizons and partnership with ALR."
Gateway and ALR agreed the North Sioux City, S.D.-based direct marketer of personal computers would buy ALR for $194 million. Under the terms of the deal, Gateway will pay $15.50 a share for ALR.

ALR, for its part, said it does not know anything about the talks.
"We see this as a tremendous opportunity," ALR chief executive Gene Lu said. "We'll worry about those other issues later."
